baseline_protocol.tinysam: Official decoder forward: three public masks, highest native predicted-IoU score, for Point and Box.
baseline_protocol.mobilesam: Official decoder forward: Point round 1 uses three public masks and highest native predicted-IoU score; Box uses native single-mask output. Later point rounds use native single-mask output.

curation.scope: Qualitative example and prompt selection only; no fitting, calibration, thresholds, weights or aggregate evaluations changed.
curation.selection: Frozen predictions reviewed on a bounded existing CC BY example pool; candidate audits and rejected examples retained locally.
